### Prerequisites
- GitHub Advisory package range: actions `actions/download-artifact` >= 4.0.0, < 4.1.3; first patched 4.1.3. [[ghsa](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cxww-7g56-2vh6)]

### Input / trigger
- Affected product and an abstract condition are public (path traversal). No concrete request or public PoC URL was found, so none is stated here. [[ghsa](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cxww-7g56-2vh6)]

### Expected (patched) vs vulnerable behavior
- Vulnerable builds match the cited range and GitHub Advisory characterizes the issue as path traversal. GHSA first patched version: 4.1.3. Patched builds are those outside that range. The advisory text was paraphrased, not copied. [[ghsa](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cxww-7g56-2vh6)]

### How to confirm
- Not possible from public sources beyond the affected-versus-patched range above. No concrete input was published, so none was invented. [[ghsa](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cxww-7g56-2vh6)]

excerpts.text:
### Impact

Versions of `actions/download-artifact` before 4.1.3 are vulnerable to arbitrary file write when downloading and extracting a specifically crafted artifact that contains path traversal filenames.

### Patches

Upgrade to version 4.1.3 or higher. Alternatively use 'v4' tag which points to the latest and secure version.

### References

- https://snyk.io/research/zip-slip-vulnerability
- https://github.com/actions/download-artifact/releases/tag/v4.1.3
- https://github.com/actions/downl
